thread.externalNotice: You are writing to another organization. Who reads, and since when, is always shown on the right.
thread.personalNotice: Personal conversation — nobody else from your workspace can see it.
thread.absent: There is no conversation here yet.
thread.absentHint: The conversation opens once both sides have an account and the mandate has been accepted.
thread.absentOfficeHint: Only the mandate team and the owner can see this conversation — or it has not opened yet because the owner has no account.
thread.failed: The conversation could not be loaded.
thread.closed: This conversation is closed and accepts no new messages. Its history remains.
thread.empty: No messages yet. Write the first one.

message.retractedRead: This message was retracted — it had already been read.
message.retractedUnread: This message was retracted before anyone saw it.
message.retractWindow: Can be retracted for {minutes, plural, one {# more minute} other {# more minutes}}
message.retractConfirmBody: The text will leave the conversation for both sides; it will show that it was retracted, and you will learn whether it had already been read. For record-keeping the text is kept in a closed archive that nobody can see.
message.retractDoneRead: Retracted — the other side had already read it.
message.editNotice: It will show as edited; the previous version is kept in a closed archive.
message.editDoneAfterRead: Saved — the other side had already read the previous version.

composer.label: New message
composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

roster.title: Who reads this
roster.solo: Only you are in this conversation — no one else has joined yet.

away.nobody: Nobody reads in their place until then.

mine.title: My time away
mine.none: You have not set any time away.
mine.scheduled: You will be away from {from} to {to}.
mine.hint: While you are away, the people who read with you are notified in your place. Dates only — no message.
mine.invalid: Check the dates: the end must be after the start, within one year.

seat.muteHint: Messages still arrive, you just are not notified. The other side is not told.
seat.followHint: As a collaborator you are notified only when the lead is away. Turn this on to always be notified.

team.title: The mandate team
team.visibleNotice: Every change is visible to the other side too, with who reads and since when.
team.addSelfNotice: If you add yourself, the other side will see it.

outcome.unchanged: No change needed — it was already so.
outcome.conflict: Someone else changed the team in the meantime. Review the current version and try again.

failure.thread-absent: The conversation does not exist or you have no access.
failure.not-audience: The conversation does not exist or you have no access.
failure.thread-closed: The conversation is closed and accepts no changes.
failure.already-retracted: The message had already been retracted.
failure.stale-version: Someone else made a change in the meantime.
failure.window-expired: The retraction window has passed. You can edit it or write a correction.
failure.not-sender: Only the sender can change it.
failure.not-permitted: You are not allowed to do this.
failure.target-not-in-workspace: This person is not an active member of the agency.
failure.target-is-counterpart: The owner cannot join the agency team.
failure.responsible-not-removable: The lead cannot be removed — assign a new lead first.
failure.internal-error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
failure.unreachable: No connection. Check your network and try again.
